The claim states that the technique is implemented in two stages: first using Voxel Cone Tracing (VCT) to build probes without hardware RT, and later migrating to hardware-accelerated ray tracing (RTX/DXR/RadeonRays). The evidence explicitly confirms this plan: 'We plan on rolling DDGI in two stages: DDGI built from VCT. The evidence also notes that the first stage does not require raytracing hardware ('without having to prepare for raytracing') and the second stage uses the specified hardware technologies.
